tei:div.tei:p: 147) ༄༅/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i sgrubs thabs nyer mkho gud du bton pa gnam lcags zhun ma bzhugs so// 148) ༄༅/

bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir gtor bzlog gi las sbyor gang du sbrel ba ni/ chos sde 'di nyid kyi rtsa gsum chos skyong thams cad yin kyang*/ dper mtshon na bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum las/ bla ma drag po phyi bsgrub ni/ bdag mdun gu ru drag po'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas dkar zhal: g.yon zhal sngon po dang po gnyis: gri gug thod khrag de yi 'og: rdo rje sdig pa de 'og gnyis: ral gri kha ṭ+wām̐ 'dzin pa ste: sku mdog dmar po 149)me dpung 'bar: dur khrod chas kyis sku la brgyan: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum dor stabs bsgrad: klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su: o rgyan pad+ma sku mdog dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis lcags kyu bhan: dar dkar gsol zhing skyil krung bzhugs: mgrin par gser gyi 'khor lo'i nang: o rgyan pad+ma sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis lcag sgrog bhan: 150) dar dmar gsol zhing skyil krung bzhugs: thugs kar mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i nang: o rgyan pad+ma sku mdog smug: zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'khor lo bhan: dar smug gsol zhing skyil krung bzhugs: lte bar chos 'byung zur drug nang: o rgyan pad+ma sku mdog ser: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhags pa bhan: dar ser gsol zhing skyil krung bzhugs: gsang ba gru gsum nag po'i dbus: o rgyan pad+ma sku mdog ljang: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgya gram bhan: dar ljang gsol zhing skyil krung bzhugs: g.yon nas yum mchog sngon mo 'khyud: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug khrag: khro mo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs bsgrad: rtsa sngags ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.a rtsig ne rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: 151) bla ma drag po'i gsang sgrub ni/ bdag mdun gu ru drag po ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon sdig pa: khro bo'i chas ni ma lus rdzogs: dpral bar rdo rje thod phreng rtsal:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis ber dkar gsol: g.yas pas ḍā ru g.yon bhan+dha: bhan+dha'i nang du rdo rje bslang: zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar 'jam dpal ni: gshin rje gshed kyi skur bzhengs pa: sku mdog ser po zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis ral gri po ti 'dzin: gcer bu dbu skra gyen du 'bar: khro bo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhengs: mgrin par pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis ber dmar gsol: g.yas pa ḍā ru g.yon bhan+dha: bhan+dha'i nang du pad+ma bslang: 152) zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar 'jig rten mgon: rta mgrin dmar po'i skur bzhengs pa: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis dbyug rdo thod khrag 'dzin: gcer bu dbu skra gyen du 'bar: khro bo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhengs: thugs kar bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis ber smug gsol: g.yas pas ḍā ru g.yon bhan+dha: bhan+dha'i nang du 'khor lo bslang: zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar mthu chen thob: phyag na rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pa: sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad: gcer bu dbu skra gyen du 'bar: khro bo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhengs: lte bar rat+na thod phreng rtsal: zhal gcig 153)phyag gnyis ber ser gsol: g.yas pas ḍā ru g.yon bhan+dha: bhan+dha'i nang du rin chen bslang: zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar dbyangs can ma: khros ma nag mo'i skur bzhengs pa: sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: gcer bu dbu skra gyen du 'bar: khro mo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhengs: gsang bar karma thod phreng rtsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis ber ljang gsol: g.yas pas ḍā ru g.yon bhan+dha: bhan+dha'i nang du rgya gram bslang: zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: de yi thugs kar sgrib sel ni:

yak+sha me dbal skur bzhengs pa: sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis tho ba me zhags 'dzin: gcer bu 154)dbu skra gyen du 'bar: khro bo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs bzhengs: spu gri'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon gdengs: gshog pa'i rtse nas bya khyung 'gyed: spyi bor 'od dpag med pa ni: dmar po mnyam gzhag skyil krung bzhugs: g.yon nas yum mchog dmar ser ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis 'khyud: shar du rdo rje drag po dkar: rdo rje sdig pa khro chas rdzogs: lho ru rat+na drag po ser: rin chen sdig pa khro chas rdzogs: nub tu pad+ma drag po dmar: pad+ma sdig pa khro chas rdzogs: byang du karma drag po ljang: rgya gram sdig pa khro chas rdzogs: de rgyab g.yas steng hūm̐ ka ra: dkar po lag na mda' gzhu 'gengs: shar du rnam par rgyal ba ni: sngon po lag na ral gri 'dzin: 155)shar lhor dbyug pa sngon po ni: sngon po lag na dbyug pa 'dzin: lho ru gshin rje gshed po ni: ser po lag na be con 'dzin: lho nub mi g.yo mgon po ni: smug po lag na 'khor lo 'dzin: nub tu rta mgrin rgyal po ni: dmar po lag na thod dbyug 'dzin: nub byang gzhan gyi mi thub ni: dmar po lag na lcags kyu 'dzin: byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ni: ljang gu lag na rgya gram 'dzin: byang shar khams gsum rnam rgyal ni: ljang sngon lag na rtse gsum 'dzin: g.yon gyi 'og tu stobs po che: sngo nag lag na dbyug pa 'dzin: g.yon rnams lag na bhan+dha 'dzin: de yi shar du yul 'khor srung: dkar po lag na pi waṃ 'dzin: de yi lho ru 'phags skyes po: sngon 156)po lag na ral gri 'dzin: de yi nub tu spyan mi bzang: dmar po lag na sbrul zhags 'dzin: de yi byang du rnam thos sras: ser po lag na rgyal mtshan 'dzin: phyag na rdo rje'i thugs ka ru: gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs dang ldan: de yi dbus su hūm̐ dmar la:

rtsa sngags kyi ni g.yas su bskor: oṃ a rtsika ne rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ a phaṭa: badz+ra hūm̐: yak+sha phaṭa: rak+sha hūm̐: bla ma drag po phur mjug can ni/ stong pa'i ngang las gur drag phur mjug can: zhal bzhi phyogs bzhir bltas nas rgyal 'gong 'dul: phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang: sdig pa 'dzin te 'og gnyis gri kha ṭ+wām̐: sku smad phur pa dbal dang ldan pa ni: rgyal bsen snying gar dbal mi thub par zug: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes pa spyan drangs: 157) dbang lha rnams kyis dbang bskur rigs bdag mtshan: de yi thugs kar hūm̐ las sngags g.yas bskor: sngags de drag tu 'khor bas 'grub par gyur: oṃ a rtsika ne rtsika na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gro lod ni/ bdag mdun rdo rje gro lod sku mdog smug nag aṃ gtsigs bsdams pa ral pa spyi bor bcings pa: g.yas rdo rje g.yon phur pa bsnams pa: phod kha sngon po thang sham dang chos gos dmar po can: mi mgo'i phreng ba sa brgyan pa: snyan gnyis dung gi wang mig gis mtshan pa: stag mo grus ma'i steng na dor stabs su bzhugs pa me ri dmar nag tu 'phro bar gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gnyis pa yi dam la/ sgrub pa sde brgyad spyir sgrub pa dang*/ bye brag pa'o/ dang po ni/ hūm̐: dbyings las rang byung 158)grub pa'i lha: dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med pa'i: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas pa'i phyag gsum rdo rje gsor: g.yon pa'i phyag gsum bhan+dha 'dzin: yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud gri gug ste: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa'i steng: bskal pa'i me dpung klong du bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa:

ma hā kro dhi shwa ri s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: 159)g.yas gsum be con ral gri s+t+waḥ g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung bhan dmar: yum chen badz+ra be ta li: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ āḥkro te ka yā mān+ta ka hā na ma tha bhan dza hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: mgrin par dbang chen rta mchog rgyal: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ zhags: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar sgrog: yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wām̐ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ pad+ma ta 160)krita ma hā kro dha ha ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: thugs kar badz+ra he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdil: g.yon gsum dril bhan rgyu zhags bsnams: yum chen kro ti shwa ri 'khyud: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+waṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lte bar bla med he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung sbrul zhags: g.yon gsum bhan+dha zhing ga'u: yum chen nyid bzhi mu 161)kha 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ kha: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: ma lnga la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa:

hūm̐: gsang bar rdo rje gzhon nu che: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga ste: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: tha gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: brla g.yas stobs 162)ldan nag po che: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: dbu gsum mthing nag 'jigs pa la: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad snying: g.yon gsum bhan+dha klu brgyad snying: yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mo 'khril: g.yas pas gzugs khams mkha' la 'degs: g.yon pas 'dod khams sa la gnon: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: brla g.yon dregs pa kun 'dul rje: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad mgo: g.yon gsum bhan+dha klu brgyad mgo: yum chen srid pa spyi 'dul 'khril: g.yas pas 163)gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: spyi gtsug rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bsgrad: sku mdog dkar dmar rus rgyan mdzes: rigs lngas dbu brgyan thugs srog gsal: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya bsgyur: yum chen chos dbyings rnal 'byor 'khril: gnyis med 'khril sbyor bde chen bskyed: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kar ye shes sems: mthing nag zhi ba'i cha byad can:

rdo rje dang ni dril bu bsnol: dor stabs bzhugs pa tshon gang tsam: de yi thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag: nas 164)'bru tsam la sngags 'dis bskor: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhi shwa ri badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha ka la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: gnyis pa bye brag pa lnga/ dang po 'jam dpal sku yi skor la/ gshed dmar ni/ bdag mdun gshin rje gshed dmar ni: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas mthing g.yon nag dbus dmar zhal: g.yas gsum dbyug rdo rdo rje gri: thod khrag dril bu kha ṭ+waṃ g.yon: oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hrīḥhūm̐ swa hā: tshe bdag nag po ni/ tshe bdag nag po zhal gcig pa: phyag bzhi phyag mtshan 'di ltar ro: ral gri be con zhags pa dang: bhan+dha 'dzin te zhabs gnyis bsgrad: yum ni ljang sngon g.yas nas 'khyud: oṃ ya ya ma ma: du du ya du ya du a: ne kro dha ya: ma ma rā tsa ha ling ha liṃ: 165) ha la ha la: ya du ya du hūm̐ phaṭa: sngags rgyas pa'o/ oṃ ya ma du ya yā: a kro ya: rā tsa haliṃ: ha la ya du hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ma ya a kro rā tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: ༈ oṃ a kro rā tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: ༈ rdo rje 'jigs byed ni/ de dbus gru gsum glang rgod zung bzhi'i steng: pad+ma nyi zla bam gyi gdan steng du: rang sems hūm̐ mthing 'od kyis don gnyis byas: gdug pa tshar bcad rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus: hūm̐: mthing yongs gyur skad cig dran rdzogs su: dpal chen ya mān+ta ka mthing nag 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis dor stabs bsgrad: ma he'i gdong can shangs la khro gnyer bsdus: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs gad rgyangs sgrog: gnam lcags rwa co sngo dkar me lce 'bar: spyan gsum dmar zlum 166) sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug: shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma sbud: ag tshom smin ma me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: ral pa gyen gzings thod skam rtse bran lnga: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin:

glang po zhing lpags stag gi sham thabs gsol: tshangs skud rgyan drug sbrul rigs lnga yis brgyan: sbrul nag thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang: oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes dang*/ oṃ ya ma rā dza parba me ya: ya ma de ru ṇa ye da ya: ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: khro chu ni/ bdag mdun las kyi gshin rje sku mdog mthing nag dug sbrul gyi shun pa gyon pa: phyag gnyis dgra s+t+wa dang tsit+ta 'dzin pa: sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa byad ma'i snying la 167)'dzer bar bsam: oṃ tri du tri du phuṃ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ king kang ni/ bdag mdun gshin rje king kang smug: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs drug bsgrad: pang du yum mchog sngon mo khyud: g.yas gsum gra s+t+wa khram shing dang: lcags kyu g.yon ni 'di lta ste: tho ba zhags pa be con 'dzin: khro bo'i chas kun ma lus rdzogs: oṃ king kang thuṃ hril dgra nan: 'char ka ni/ bdag mdun 'char ka sku mdog nag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yi: khram shing g.yon pas mchod rten ni: spyi bo'i gtsug tu khur ba la: gshin rje'i chas kun yongs su rdzogs: yig chung la sogs thogs pa yi: 'khor du shan 'byed gnyis kyis bskor: oṃ sha ri ru ma bh+yo dgra bzlog:

'jam dpal na ga rak+sha ni/ 168)bdag mdun nā ga rak+sha ni: zhal gcig phyag bzhi khro bo'i gzugs: dang po gnyis kyis gri thod 'dzin: de 'og ral gri sbrul zhags 'dzin: sbrul mgo bdun brgyan de steng du: khyung gi mgo dang gshog pas brgyan: sku mdog nam mkha'i mdog lta bu: sku smad sbrul gyi mjug ma la: sku stod khro bo'i cha byad can: oṃ nā ga rā tsa phe laṃ hūm̐: gnyis pa pad+ma gsung la/ rta dmar ni/ bdag mdun dbang chen rta mgrin ni: sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig pa: dbu gtsug thor cog rta dbu gnyis: thor cog rtse nas rta dbus brgyan: dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang: 'og ma'i phyag ni gnyis na ni: dbyug to dang ni zhags pa 'dzin: sku smad phur pa chu srin mal: rta dbus brgyan cing dbal 169)gsum na: klu sbrul dug sbrul nag pos brgyan: oṃ hā ya gh+ri wa hūm̐ phaṭa: ki la ya swā hā: rta nag ni/ bdag mdun khro rgyal rta mgrin ni: sku mdog nag po zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis ral gri lcags zhags 'dzin: rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher: sku la ber nag brjid pa gsol: khro bo'i chas rdzogs dor stabs zhabs: sbrul rigs lnga dang ro nyi pad: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: dkar ser dmar ljang rang 'dra bzhi: phyogs bzhir gsal bar bskyed pa'o: thugs ka'i hrīḥnag sngags 'khor las: 'od zer 'phros nas ye shes pa: spyan drangs bskyed pa de la thim: dbang bskur rigs bdag dbu brgyan gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ na mo ha ya gri wa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: na ma sang sang ham̐'u hūm̐ 170)phaṭa phaṭa: hrī hrī: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ na mo: ha ya gṛ wa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hrī hrī hrīḥphaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥswā hā: ༈ oṃ ha ya gre wa hūm̐: yak+sha kā la chen po gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la rbad rbad: na ga'i snying la rbad rbad: gnod byed 'byung po'i khrag la rbad rbad: na ga'i khrag la rbad rbad:

gnod byed 'byung po'i sha la rbad rbad: na ga'i sha la rbad rbad: gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la rbad rbad: na ga'i snying la rbad rbad: gnod byed 'byung po'i srog la rbad rbad: na ga'i srog la rbad rbad: 'dod chags khrag la rbad rbad: na ga'i khrag la rbud rbud: nga rgyal snying la rbad rbad: na ga'i snying la rbud rbud: zhe sdang rus la rbad rbad: na ga'i rus la rbud rbud: gti mug sha la 171)rbad rbad: na ga'i sha la rbud rbud: phrag dog srog la rbad rbad: na ga'i srog la rbud rbud: gnod byed 'byung po dgra bgegs thams cad kyi snying rtsa la chod chod: srog rtsa la chod chod: sha tshos khrag skam raṃ khaṃ ma ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gsum pa yang dag thugs skor las/ phyag rdor mtha' yas ni/ khro chen mtha' yas sku mdog sngo: dbu brgya phyag ni nyis brgya dang: drug 'gyur rtsa ba'i phyag drug ste: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub: zhags pa 'dzin te de 'og gnyis: g.yas pas ri rab g.yon pas 'brug: tha g.yas nam mkhar mdzub mo gtod: g.yon pa'i phyag gis mchog sbyin mdzad: tha ma brgya yi g.yas pa rnams: rdo rje g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub zhags: pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs: dbu la thod skam dbu rgyan 172)gsol: rus pa'i rgyan chas sku la brgyan: mdzes pa'i phyir du khrag zhag byugs: gsang ba'i phyir du stag sham gsol: mi glang pags pa rgyab na gsol: phyag zhabs sbrul rgyan do shal byas: thod rlon lnga bcu mgul du 'phyang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra pā ṇi maṃ bhan+dha ra ma na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: log tri pa la ni/ log tri pa la drag po'i sku: khro bo nag po phyag bzhi pa: g.yas pas ri rab g.yon nyi ma: 'og gnyis ral gri phur pa 'dril: oṃ lok+tṛ pā la nan: sa ga pa sha nan: na ga du maṃ nan: ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsid tsa ra tsid tsa ra: rbad da ru lu ya: rbad da ru lu ya: rbad tra ko sha ya: rbad tra ko sha ya:

ho ra ho ra: tsi du sod: tsi du sod: shig 173)lhur gtub: ha la pa ti nan: 'khor ba sarba dul: gnod byed kā wa tsit+ta rlag rlag: ༈ oṃ log tri pā la nan: nā ga du maṃ nan: tsid tsa ra tsid tsa ra: rbad tra ko sha ya: rbad tra ko sha ya: rbad tra ko sha ya: tsa du sod: rtsi du sod: dum bum khrol: 'khor ba dul: a mu kaṃ tsit+ta brlag brlag: ༈ oṃ lok+t+ri pā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥswā hā: khyung dmar ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid kyi mgo thig leḥ lag gnyis na ro: lus po kha: rkang pa gnyis ra btags su bsam la 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: sems can thams cad kyi don byas: tshur 'dus khrom yongs su gyur pa las: bdag nyid khyung dmar me phreng thog rgod can: sku mdog dmar po zhal nas khrom khrom sgrog pa: klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad 'dar 174)zhing bsngangs pa: sbrul rigs lnga klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad kyi tshul du mgo khar bcug nas me gshog rdeb pa gcig tu bsam: oṃ khrom ga ru ḍā nā ga le hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ khrom ga ru ḍā nā ga le dum pa le pa tang te ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥbh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥdza dza dzaḥphaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: che ge mo rak+sha rak+sha: bzhi pa phur pa phrin las ni/ bdag mdun rdo rje phur pa ni: sku mdog de ni sngo nag la: zhal gsum g.yas zhal dkar po'o: g.yon zhal de ni dmar po'o: phyag drug phyag mtshan 'di lta ste: g.yas kyi dang po gnyis na ni: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga 'dzin: g.yon gyi dang po gnyis kyis ni: rtsa gsum me dpung 'dzin pa'o: g.yas kyi 'og ma ri rab 'dzin: g.yon gyi 'og mas phur pa 'dzin: sku smad gnam lcags phur pa ste: dgra gdon bgegs 175)rnams snying gar gzir: khro bo'i chas rnams yongs rdzogs bsam: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: lnga pa ma mo rbod gtong la/ seng gdong ma ni/ seng gdong lha mo sku mdog sngo: zhal gcig zhal steng seng ge'i zhal: phyag bzhi gri gug thod khrag dang:

kha ṭ+wāṃ phur pa 'dzin pa'o: sku smad phur pa dbal dang ldan: sku ni gcer bu rus rgyan can: dam ye dbyer med dran rdzogs gsal: oṃ badz+ra dha ki ni seng ha mu kha hūm̐phaṭa: aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥr tsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ gsum pa mkha' 'gro'i skor la/ khros ma ni/ bdag mdun rdo rje khros ma ni: sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig pa: phyag bzhi phyag mtshan 'di ltar ro: dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang: thod khrag de 'og gnyis kyis ni: zhing 176)lpags dang ni rkang gling 'dzin: oṃ badz+ra wa ra hi kro dhi ka li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā: de dag ni gnam chos thugs gter las bkol ba'i le tshan no/ zhar byung 'ja' tshon gter byon gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo 'di dang sbrel na/ āḥ chos rnams smra bsam brjod med stong pa nyid: oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i gdugs dkar yongs gyur las: dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med rang nyid ni: rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog chen mo'i sku: dbu stong mdun zhal sgeg pa'i zhal nyis brgya: g.yas zhal nyis brgya 'jigs rung dgod pa ser: rgyab zhal dmar po nyis brgya gshe dang rngams: g.yon zhal ljang gu nyis brgya snying rje zhi: steng zhal sngon po nyis brgya dregs la gtum: dbu rer rdo rje'i mtshan rtags spyan gsum gsum: sku mdog dkar zhing spyan mig bye ba 'bum: zur mig bgrad pas glog 'gyu drag tu gzigs: g.yas 177)phyag lnga brgya g.yon phyag lnga brgya yis: thams cad gsod gcod ral gri 'bar ba phyar: zhabs g.yas lnga brgya brkyang pas 'jigs kun mnan: zhabs g.yon lnga brgya bskum pas gdon kun mnan: sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun cod pan 'chang: dbu gtsug gdugs kar bdun ni brtsegs mar 'khor: ba spu thams cad ye shes 'od zer 'bar: lha rdzas na bza' zhi khro'i rgyan dang ldan: dpral bar rnam snang thugs kar oṃ dkar po: mgrin par snang mtha'i thugs kar āḥdamar po: thugs smad rdor sems thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po:

thugs dbus zla steng oṃ yig dkar po'i mthar: sngags phreng 'od kyis sgrib bsal mthu stobs rgyas: ya so khro bcu ma so khro mo bcu: sma ra me dpung ral gri ngar ma'i lce: mgrin par nyi zla rang lus 178)me dpung 'bar: gnod byed thams cad gzhob tu bsregs par gyur: thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'khor las: 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs bstim: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ mam hūm̐ ni swa hā: oṃ ma ma hūm̐ ni swa hā: mdos zor sha khrag gi tshab/ bh+yo: bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs rnams: mthu stobs thogs pa mi mnga' zhing: thugs rje smon lam mthu btsan pas: bdag gis gsol ba btab pa bzhin: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang: sems can thams cad bde gyur cig: rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi: chags che nyams nga bzlog tu gsol: rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa bzlog: rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa bzlog: dgra 'dre'i bsam sbyor ngan pa bzlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig bzlog: ye 'drogs 179) sum brgya drug cu bzlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu bzlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad bzlog: yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa bzlog: mas kyi sri ru langs ba bzlog: dpral ba'i gshed du brkos pa bzlog: pha mes dur sri langs ba bzlog: mi la na tsha gtong ba bzlog: phyugs la god kha bye pa bzlog: gnam gyi dal kha thebs pa bzlog: sa yi dug mda' g.yos pa bzlog: sme ba spar kha ngan pa bzlog: kag dang phung sri langs ba bzlog tu gsol: zhes btang pas mthus so/ zhes pa'ang ma ṇis so// dge'o// 180)
